description: This source file defines core components of an AI agent service, including data models for agent steps, tools, errors, and the main AgentService class that manages interactions with a language model, executes tools, and parses responses.

classes.name: AgentService
classes.description: An observable object managing the AI agent's interaction flow, including message exchange, tool execution, and response parsing.

methods.name: runAgent
methods.description: Main method that runs the agent loop: sends messages to the language model, parses responses, executes actions via tools, and records steps.

methods.name: addStep
methods.description: Adds a new interaction step to the steps history with timestamp.

methods.name: setupTools
methods.description: Initializes built-in tools such as read_file, write_to_file, get_current_time, and calculate.

methods.name: executeAction
methods.description: Parses and executes an action command using available tools.

methods.name: parseAction
methods.description: Parses an action string into tool name and arguments.

methods.name: parseArguments
methods.description: Splits a string of arguments into a list, handling quotes and commas.

methods.name: extractThought
methods.description: Extracts the <thought> content from a model response.

methods.name: extractAction
methods.description: Extracts the <action> content from a model response.

methods.name: extractFinalAnswer
methods.description: Extracts the <final_answer> content from a model response.

methods.name: extractContent
methods.description: Helper method that uses regex to parse specific XML tags.

methods.name: generateSystemPrompt
methods.description: Creates the prompt string instructing the language model how to respond and interact.
